**Task complete.** Both tests pass.

The issue was a mutable default argument. In Python, `bucket=[]` is evaluated once when the function is defined, not on each call. The same list object gets reused and accumulates items from previous calls. Fixed by using `None` as the default and creating a new list when needed.
